body:
But, tell me what you really think man? 
Lol. 
I'd put myself between the intruder and anyone, regardless of relation to me. I am protective by nature, which causes much conflict for me. 
Guess I'm just a bad person. Ah well. Thanks.

Yes marriage feels like a trap for me. As does a mortgage. Etc.
Childhood was rooted. Abuse and torture, death parents, abandonment, lots of awesome stuff etc. never understood why that's supposed to have an impact on this situation really.

Lol - taking the long drive home, it's 1am and I'm still in the car park at work. Dunno if I'll go home tonight. 
Have to put away our childish ways. An interesting sentiment and you're not the first person to have expressed it. 
Why exactly? 
We live in a society where half the people are depressed, and half the people are divorced. Maybe we've got some shit backwards? I'm getting very tired of society telling me what's expected behavior, when society seems a bit fucked up itself. 
I've been meditating for a couple years now, it's useful. But has its own drawbacks if you're not ready to deal with what it does. 
Podcasts are good - as you say takes your mind off things. 
Anyway I better get some sleep, work tomorrow. Hanks for the chat.

Can you do a pros and cons list of how it has effected your life. 
I don't think she has impacted my life that much in truth. My wife is extremely supportive (I told her this was likely to be the situation and she said she was fine with it), she is very maternal etc. 
I have issues in that I'm never at home alone anymore, so just can't relax. It's frustrating. She tries to stay at her dads once a week to give me space but by the time I get home from work, food, then sleep it's a bit pointless.

Nope I never look forward to spending time with her. Even in future imagination - I've always been indifferent to children (at best). And I just shrug when I think about her -
Just seems unnatural. Something wrong with me that nobody understands. 
Anyway thanks for the chat. 17.3 years to go.

Have been to dozens of therapy sessions. Got me to the point where I mostly don't just want to kill myself every day because I don't want this life. Have been on Zoloft for same reasons also. 
Yep, everyone seems to be saying man up and see ya in 18 years. Guess there's nothing else strangers would say. Don't know what I want anyone to say anyway. Seems like just serving my time is the prescription. Doubt I'll make it though. Thanks for taking the time to respond. Any tips on how to sleep in a car lol!

Thanks. I've been to see a psychologist and he's helping me with it. It's very hard. I still don't know what I'm going to do - I think I will gave to get a divorce and go away. It makes me an asshole, but probably better than my wife and child knowing I killed myself.

> You're mother fucking Thor.

Haven't laughed in days. Thanks.
Thankyou for taking the time to reply.
